findings.summary: WP-006 primary verdict: FALSIFIED by the frozen verdict mapping. Producers 2/4 (books 12, quotes 12 verified BPs), total verified matched branch points 38 < 60 director floors; no hard validity-gate failure (G2/G4/G5/G7 green), execution adequate ⇒ not DATA_INSUFFICIENT; independent in-team verifier PASS with own reference path and 0 rows predating the freeze. This exact outcome was later accepted through five independent audit gates on lab/physics (final gate CYCLE_32866107906 PASS, safe_to_integrate=true) and engaged the pre-declared TERMINATE_LANE stop condition — subsequently superseded organizationally by V3 domain reopening, with WP-006 itself never reopened.

Mandatory decomposition (team report §2): wherever execution succeeded, matched-state restarts reproduced ~100% (calibration double-reset control passed on all calibrated BPs as reported by the team) and T2 responses were near-deterministic — 101/102 cells with ≥1 valid trial had all-identical outcome distributions. The floor miss was localized to instrument-side causes: frozen ordinal-0 anchor slot selecting non-actionable skip-links on wikipedia/gutenberg (171 action_failed exclusions zeroing 24 otherwise-reproducible BPs), openlibrary page-weight timeouts (+13 state_match failures, 4/42 valid), and stateful BP plans (≤8) below the ≥10 producer bar despite saucedemo verifying 7/7. Dataset wp006_v1: 8 sites attempted (5 static + 3 stateful), 164 calibration + 910 trial rows = 704 valid / 206 invalid.

Independent auditor recomputed everything from scratch (agreement on all headline numbers) but found the report's decomposition misstated its own control: openlibrary has 12 recorded calibration pairs of which only 5 pass and 7 genuinely fail the frozen tolerance (button_bucket drift |Δn|=42>3) ⇒ true FN-control figure 62/74, not '62/62'. Root cause chain: openlibrary hard timeout killed collection before the per-site BP-manifest dump → merged manifest silently lacked openlibrary → both manifest-fed verifier C2 coverage check (actual coverage 868/910, undisclosed) and D5 skipped it. Also: report cited verifier C2 as '806 comparable rows' vs JSON's actual 868, and the prereg-promised G5 chosen-descriptor↔pre-menu check does not exist in verify_wp006.py (structural re-check passed, so no substantive leakage). Auditor held REVISE precisely because this decomposition feeds the lane-termination decision. NOTE: the final accepted figure after the repair chain is 67/74 (commit 2f2b84e) — use that number for any downstream citation.

Instrument-side lesson for any future interventional Web-physics collection: a single frozen slot-selection rule (ordinal-0 anchor) silently selected accessibility skip-links on two site skins and zeroed 24 BPs; silent BP-manifest truncation under timeout degraded BOTH verification coverage and calibration accounting without failing any hard gate. Validity gates caught none of this; only adversarial recomputation did.

~3h27m wall clock for a complete falsification cycle (team 3h11m live Playwright collection over 8 sites + 15m audit + dispatch overhead). Model opencode/x-preview-f-free; ubuntu-24.04 runner; opencode installed ad hoc per job via curl|bash. Two mid-run instrument repairs were absorbed pre-outcome with hash preservation instead of restarting the cycle.

failure_signatures: SILENT_MANIFEST_TRUNCATION: per-site BP-manifest dump skipped when a site hard-times-out mid-collection; merged manifest then quietly omits that site and every manifest-fed check reports 'pass' with reduced coverage unless coverage denominators are themselves audited.

FROZEN_SLOT_RULE_BLINDNESS: prereg-frozen deterministic slot selection (ordinal-0 anchor) can be systematically non-actionable on specific DOM skins (skip-links), converting into large valid-trial losses counted only as action_failed exclusions.

PERSISTENCE_PATH_BUG_PATTERN (pre-outcome): trial rows were persisted only on the exception path, not normal completion (fixed d8303d2); nested sync-playwright crash in static BP resolution (fixed a5c5112). Both caught before any outcome observation.
research_opportunities: Closed by later decisions: WP-006 program terminated per frozen stop rule (accepted, 5th-gate PASS) and Physics succession handled under V3 (orthogonal successor search handed to CTO portfolio, commit c15321c). No rescue variants are permitted. Residual transferable idea, already noted in accepted decomposition: state reproducibility + near-deterministic matched-state response succeeded everywhere execution existed — relevant only if a materially orthogonal Physics program needs an identifiability-preserving instrument design (avoid ordinal-anchor slots; enforce per-site manifest emission with completion assertions).
